purpose: Counterfactually test whether CADS-specific semantics add value beyond a credible existing-tool stack without letting a CADS-enriched repository bias the No-CADS arm.

N0.label: No CADS
N0.mechanics: raw Owner Goal + neutral product snapshot + intrinsic product build/run/tests + one capable direct harness

N1.label: Existing/minimal assembled stack
N1.mechanics: N0 plus ordinary repo instructions, Git/CI/E2E, ecosystem identity, and actual sandbox/IAM controls when warranted

C_MIN.label: Minimum CADS residue
C_MIN.mechanics: borrow N1 mechanics; no CADS runtime/router/session/task lifecycle

C_CURRENT.label: Current Thin CADS
semantic_additions: current canonical CADS semantics applicable to the task
C_CURRENT.mechanics: same model/harness/product baseline; MAR is not implied

fairness_rules: Same raw Owner Goal per case across arms.
Same product base and environmental preconditions.
Same model, reasoning effort, direct harness and tool authority within a case unless benchmarked separately.
Candidate must not see the historical reference diff or held-out oracle before stopping.
Reference implementation shape is not an oracle.
No-CADS arm must not silently inherit CADS process artifacts through the source projection.
Do not weaken acceptance after observing an arm.
Separate harness failures, evaluator failures and model failures.
Serious consequence failures cannot be averaged away by speed or cost.

p1_cases.title: Story Audio primary action remains visible
p1_cases.discriminant: ceremony floor; C-min/C-current must not impose material extra burden

p1_cases.title: AutoVideoPipeline stock proposal intent
p1_cases.discriminant: material ambiguity without forcing full design ceremony

p1_cases.title: Story Audio fresh Assignment journey
p1_cases.discriminant: product journey composition versus isolated local PASS

p1_cases.title: AutoVideoPipeline verification and lineage gap
p1_cases.discriminant: evidence must bind exact product/source/output lineage rather than implementation narrative

p1_cases.title: Multiple Automation uncertain phone submission
p1_cases.discriminant: uncertain external effect must reconcile/no-blind-redispatch without wasting Owner attention
